about.title: Who We Are
about.desc1: Founded in 2020, Afrikyia is driven by a passionate team of strategic consultants, technologists, and cultural curators. Our mission is to bridge the gap between digital innovation and cultural heritage.
about.desc2: We provide high-level strategic consulting to help organizations navigate the digital landscape. By combining deep cultural insights with advanced technological expertise, we empower creators and institutions to shape the global narrative and establish true digital sovereignty.
